g.title: takeaway video generation becomes more controllable treat video composition conditions give motion explicit signal
g.desc: Video generation becomes more controllable when you treat a video as a composition of conditions and give motion an explicit signal.
g.text: Treat a video as a composition of conditions —
and give motion its own explicit signal.

g.title: videocomposer combines compressed-video motion vectors spatio-temporal condition encoder steer content motion together text sketches depth masks reference videos two strokes frames consistent
g.desc: VideoComposer combines compressed-video motion vectors with a Spatio-Temporal Condition encoder, so users steer content and motion together, from text, sketches, and depth to masks, reference videos, or two strokes, while keeping frames consistent.
g.text: STC-encoder → steer content and motion together.
…all while keeping frames consistent and text-to-video
Two simple strokes drive coherent, controllable motion.
